name: Imam Yusuf Olatunji
title: Chief Imam
bio: Imam Yusuf holds a degree in Islamic Studies and has served as the chief Imam of Minhaajulhudaa Masjid since its establishment in 2020. He specializes in Qur'an recitation, Tajweed, and Fiqh.

name: Ustadh Abdullah Okafor
title: Assistant Imam
bio: Ustadh Abdullah is the assistant Imam and leads the youth programs. He holds a degree in Arabic and Islamic Studies.

name: Ustadh Ibrahim Musa
title: Muadhin
bio: Ustadh Ibrahim serves as the Muadhin, calling the Adhan for all five daily prayers with his beautiful voice.

name: Mrs. Khadijah Suleiman
title: Sisters' Coordinator
bio: Mrs. Khadijah coordinates the sisters' programs and leads the Tajweed workshops for women.
